title: 按批次和入库数量自定义唯一码（数量为10，唯一码为angleid1,angleid2....angleid10）
problem: 按批次和入库数量自定义唯一码（数量为10，唯一码为angleid1,angleid2....angleid10）
cause: 按批次和入库数量自定义唯一码（数量为10，唯一码为angleid1,angleid2....angleid10）
solution:
WITH numbers AS (
 SELECT top 500 ROW\_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS n
 FROM sys.all\_columns c1
 CROSS JOIN sys.all\_columns c2 
)
SELECT 
 b.angleid\+ CAST(aa.n AS VARCHAR(10)) AS result
FROM purindt a
JOIN batchcode b 
 ON a.angleid = b.angleid 
 AND a.entid = b.entid
JOIN numbers aa
 ON aa.n \<= a.num 
WHERE a.num \> 0 
ORDER BY a.angleid, a.entid, aa.n;
